extra.summary: The American Express Platinum Credit Card is tailored for those who relish premium experiences, particularly in dining and upscale shopping. With 10 Membership Rewards points per S$1.60 spent at selected partners, it’s ideal for maximizing high-end purchases while benefiting from an elegant lifestyle through the Chillax by Platinum program with complimentary drinks at chic bars or discounts on spa services.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.80% p.a. compounded if payment of the closing balance in your statements is not made in full; or 3% p.a. on top of prevailing interest rate in the event that your account has three or more defaults in the last 12 months
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: First 2 Supplementary Cards fee permanently waived. S$163.50 (incl. of 9% GST) for each subsequent Supplementary Card.

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income: Card application is subjected to customers meeting the regulatory minimum income requirement and internal assessment.
minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income: Card application is subjected to customers meeting the regulatory minimum income requirement and internal assessment.

our_takes.our-take: The American Express Platinum Credit Card is tailored for those who relish premium experiences, particularly in dining and upscale shopping. With 10 Membership Rewards points per S$1.60 spent at selected partners, it’s ideal for maximizing high-end purchases while benefiting from an elegant lifestyle through the Chillax by Platinum program with complimentary drinks at chic bars or discounts on spa services. However, be mindful of a 3.25% foreign transaction fee that can add up if you frequently spend overseas—this card thrives when used domestically within Singapore's vibrant luxury scene.
our_takes.good-for:
Affluent professionals looking for premium lifestyle perks like dining discounts and bespoke bar access.
Individuals seeking luxury experiences and statement credits at trending restaurants and fashion brands.
Golf enthusiasts who want complimentary green fees at premier clubs across Southeast Asia.
our_takes.things-to-note:
The annual fee is S$327; weigh whether the benefits outweigh this cost if you don't maximize rewards.
A high 27.80% interest rate means carrying a balance can lead to significant debt, costing you more.
Foreign transaction fees of 3.25% and late payment fees of S$100 can quickly add up on this card.
